description: The build history of one Cut Once run: every part state change in order, with its source (manual, voice, camera, system) and the seconds since the previous event. Use it to answer what changed, when, and how long steps took.

configuration.query: FROM cutonce-build-events | WHERE assembly_id == ?assembly_id AND kind == "part_state" | KEEP version, part_id, previous_state, new_state, source, step_id, seconds_since_prev, @timestamp | SORT version | LIMIT 100

assembly_id.description: The run to read, for example asm_run_017
